Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I see that your [‘house’](/organisation/111) appears in the list of subscribers to the [Surgical Aid Society](/organisation/16).

Do you think one or more letters could be spared to me? A little child was sent from the Society for protecting [Waifs and Strays](/organisation/2) with a lame foot paralysed after measles- to be boarded at a cottage here.

She is now in the [Orthopaedic hospital](/organisation/9), but she requires a boot and irons, and the expense is heavy, so that we should be very thankful for any letters to the surgical aid society to help us with it

Yours truly

C M Yonge
